Kind regards,

Escalating to Infrastructure. Smart Alerts for ADUSA have not run since 9/24.

1. Environment and steps to reproduce

Production, ADUSA, client 441.

  1. In LPMS, create a case on store 9998 TEST LOCATION ONLY, type Miscellaneous Investigation, with an active Smart Alert for that case type.

  2. Open Smart Alert History on the case.

  3. In Grafana, search the logger LPSBO.SmartAlert for the case ShopliftingID.

Expected: one alert run in Smart Alert History. Actual: "No Matching Alerts Found". Case 2026-AHOLD DELHAIZE USA SERVICES, LLC-9998-13, ShopliftingID 1598266, 9/25 17:52 UTC.

2. Findings

Finding

Evidence

Status

The Hatr task runs, then exits for the case

4 lines between 17:52 and 17:55 UTC for 1598266

verified

Same exit on other ADUSA cases

263 ShopliftingIDs in one export, 9/25 16:25 to 23:37 UTC

verified

Starts on 9/24

Log volume low until 9/24 morning, high and constant after

verified, read from the chart

Customer case

2026-FOOD LION ,LLC-2547-32, 9/24 around 20:20 UTC, no alert run

verified

Other clients

19 clients in the unfiltered export, 441 carries 442 of 1000 lines

verified. Normal volume for them is unknown

0. Quit ProcessSmartAlert because the smart alert for the case is still on processing. pSystemType=Case, pSystemID=1598266\n

3. Troubleshooting performed

Claude flagged the "still on processing" exit as the likely cause. I checked Smart Alert History, Change History, Incident Logs and the Grafana logs in Control Panel myself. The exit matches my test case and the customer case. My reading is that a case state stays in processing and blocks the run. Could someone else evaluate this and give me your thoughts?

Outside the ticket: Teams and a call with Kiran Vadday and Vedant Shirude on 9/25. Chris Rippingale checked SendGrid.

4. Still open

  1. Did anything change on 9/24 morning for ADUSA in Nettrack or the NettrackSmartAlert task?

  2. What sets the processing state for a case, and what clears it?

  3. Is the Quit volume for the other 18 clients normal?

Related: https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/RCS-29123 . Reported 9/21, priority Medium.

Update for Infrastructure. Smart Alert runs for ADUSA stopped completing on 9/24 around 11:06 UTC.

1. Correction

My test case 2026-AHOLD DELHAIZE USA SERVICES, LLC-9998-13 was left Open. The Smart Alert filters require Closed, so its Quit lines prove nothing by themselves. Customer case 2026-FOOD LION ,LLC-2547-32 below is the evidence.

2. Environment and steps to reproduce

Production, ADUSA, client 441, Grafana grafanacloud-apprissretail-logs.

  1. Run this query from 2026-09-20 to 2026-09-25:

{service_name=~".+", deployment_environment="usprod"} | clientId="441" |= "End of SmartAlert.ProcessSmartAlert"\n

  1. Look at the Logs volume chart.

Expected: End lines every day, as on 9/20 to 9/23. Actual: the last End is 2026-09-24 11:06:43 UTC, SystemID 1592877. None after that through 9/25.

3. Findings

Finding

Evidence

Status

Runs stopped completing

Last End 9/24 11:06:43 UTC

verified

Runs still start and exit

9/25 20:04 to 20:23 UTC: 89 Begin, 0 End, 76 "still on processing"

verified

Queue grows

ProcessAlertQueue 1. dt.Rows.Count from 217 to 222 in that window

verified

Before the break

9/20, case 0619-27, ShopliftingID 1596525: 13 Begin, 12 End, alerts inserted into SmartAlertProcess

verified

Customer case

2547-32, ShopliftingID 1598030: first save 20:20:10 UTC ran 11 alerts while Open. Every later save, including the close at 20:27:32 UTC, exits

verified

0. Quit ProcessSmartAlert because the smart alert for the case is still on processing. pSystemType=Case, pSystemID=1598030\n

4. Troubleshooting performed

Claude flagged the missing End lines as the likely cause. I ran the Grafana queries above myself, filtered by ShopliftingID 1598030 and 1596525, and compared 9/20 with 9/25. My reading is that runs no longer finish, so the processing state never clears and every later run exits. Could someone else evaluate this and give me your thoughts?

Outside the ticket: Teams and a call with Kiran Vadday and Vedant Shirude on 9/25. Chris Rippingale checked SendGrid.

5. Ruled out so far

Hypothesis

Why

Comma separated email group

SendGridEmail.vb splits To and CC on commas

6. Still open

  1. Did anything change on 9/24 between 11:06 and 14:00 UTC for Nettrack or the Hatr NettrackSmartAlert task?

  2. What clears the processing state for a case once a run starts?

Related: https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/RCS-29123 reports no alerts on 9/25. Customer reported on 9/21, priority Medium.

Resolution summary, 9/28.

Issue:
Case 2026-FOOD LION ,LLC-0619-27, ShopliftingID 1596525, 9/20 around 14:12 UTC. Smart Alert History shows two alerts as Success: External Case with Value over $1,000 to james.cosseboom, and Defrauded Customer-Food Lion to the full list. Dawn Hendry and Asset Protection did not receive the Defrauded Customer alert. btatum came from the store manager assignments for store 0619, not the alert list. Answered to the customer 9/24.

What we found:

  1. Grafana 9/20: the run completed, 13 Begin, 12 End, inserted into SmartAlertProcess.

  2. SmartAlert.vb writes Success without checking the SendGrid result. Success does not prove delivery.

  3. Chris Rippingale checked SendGrid on 9/25 and did not find the send. Russ confirmed SendGrid keeps 7 days, so 9/20 can no longer be checked. The exact cause for 0619-27 cannot be reconstructed.

  4. Duplicate recipients. Silvana.Baxter and bj.robinson were on both the alert list and the store manager CC, and Kimberly Williams appeared twice on the 0619-27 send. Kiran removed Silvana and BJ from alert config 218 on 9/27.

  5. From 9/24 all ADUSA alerts stopped. Handled on RCS-29123, PR 58273.

Verification after the fix, 9/28:
Defrauded Customer-Food Lion: 9/27 SendGrid delivered to all 26 recipients, including dawn.hendry, storepayments and RETFLAssetProtectionDivisionalMgrsALL. 9/28 ShopliftingID 1600434 at 19:36 UTC: 13b, SmartAlertProcess config 197 Success, End, no duplicate addresses.
External Case with Value over $1,000: 13b to james.cosseboom at 19:04 and 20:09 UTC.
Impersonation/Social Engineering on Food Lion goes out through Defrauded Customer-Food Lion, which covers both case types. The TGC Impersonation alert filters on the Giant/Martins division, so Rows Returned=0 on Food Lion is configuration.

Remaining, outside this ticket:
Alerts over 25MB are now rejected by SMTP. Russ found a size bounce to james.cosseboom on 9/21 08:24 UTC.
SendGrid dropped some addresses as Invalid on other alerts because they contain line breaks: jamie.holland, bj.robinson, johnna.krachinski and the RETFL list. Cleanup with Kiran.

Next: customer confirmation, then close.
Related: RCS-29123, RETAILIT-20901.
